title: goal
description: research/GOAL.json (BRIEF 6.4, Implementation Decisions 10): the quantitative goal, written by intake only when its eval_command printed the metric on a sample artifact. Every key is present; a value the owner did not state is null, never a guess.

metric.description: the name the eval command prints the value under

direction.description: up when a larger value is better

dataset_or_split.description: the data the metric is computed on

held_out_split.description: the split a kept change must improve on (the keep-if-better loop)

eval_command.description: a shell command run from the project root; {artifact} is replaced by the artifact's path, which is also exported as WAYLINE_ARTIFACT

source.description: where the number comes from: a paper, a result file, a run
